title: Import Journey Log exports
lead: Drop the .csv or .xlsx file the Polestar app mailed you. Import new exports whenever you like – only new or changed trips are added.
accepted: Journey Log .csv or .xlsx, several at once, or a polestarlize backup (.json).

error.not-journey-log: This does not look like a Journey Log export – the start date, end date or distance column is missing.
error.unreadable: The file could not be read. Is it a .csv or .xlsx from the Journey Log app?

how.title: How to get an export
how.step1: Open the Journey Log app in your Polestar (or the Polestar app, depending on your software version).
how.step2: Choose the period you want and tap “Export”.
how.step3: Enter your e-mail address. You receive a .csv and an .xlsx file with the same content.
how.step4: Import either file here. Next month, simply import the new export on top.

incremental.title: Incremental and overlap-safe
incremental.body: Trips are recognised by start time and odometer. Overlapping exports never create duplicates. If you edited trips in the app – changed a category, added a comment or merged trips – the newer export wins.

privacy: Files are read in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere unless a sync server is enabled in the settings.
